A [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of '''flying serpent''' lived on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]], and at least one specimen lived in a [[Unidentified Endor cave|cave]]. The creature had two small [[Limb/Legends|wings]] slightly forward of the midpoint of its body, and [[Color/Legends|black]] eyebrows situated above yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] with black pupils. Mostly a single shade of purple, but with a paler snout and spots on its wings, the creature had a forked [[Tongue/Legends|tongue]] and four [[Tooth/Legends|fangs]]. Its body, which was long and flexible, sported a rattle at the end, and its head featured several spikes.<ref name="The Tree of Light" /> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="EwoksDate">{{EwoksDate|appearance of the flying [[Snake/Legends|serpent]]|[[The Tree of Light]]}}</ref> the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] [[Weechee Warrick]], [[Widdle Warrick/Legends|Widdle Warrick]], [[Paploo/Legends|Paploo]], and [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] frightened one such serpent when they passed through its cave on their way to the [[Tree of Light]].<ref name="The Tree of Light" />

==Behind the scenes==
The flying serpent first appeared in "[[The Tree of Light]]," the sixth episode of the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] animated series [[Ewoks (television series)|''Ewoks'']]{{'}} [[Ewoks: Season One|first season]],<ref name="The Tree of Light" /> which originally aired on [[October 12]], [[1985]].<ref name="The Tree of Light air date">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
